title: Number of Pairs Satisfying Inequality
summary: Given two arrays nums1 and nums2 of equal size n, and an integer diff, count the pairs (i, j) where 0 <= i < j < n and nums1[i] - nums1[j] <= nums2[i] - nums2[j] + diff.
statement: Given two arrays nums1 and nums2 of equal size n, and an integer diff, count the pairs (i, j) where 0 <= i < j < n and nums1[i] - nums1[j] <= nums2[i] - nums2[j] + diff.
constraints: nums1 and nums2 have equal length from 2 through 100000.
Count index pairs i<j satisfying nums1[i]-nums1[j] <= nums2[i]-nums2[j]+diff.
Values and diff may be negative; return the total number of qualifying pairs.
reference_solution:
def count_pairs_satisfying_inequality(nums1,nums2,diff):
    import bisect
    values=[left-right for left,right in zip(nums1,nums2)];coordinates=sorted(set(values));tree=[0]*(len(coordinates)+1)
    def add(index):
        index+=1
        while index<len(tree):tree[index]+=1;index+=index&-index
    def prefix(end):
        total=0
        while end:total+=tree[end];end-=end&-end
        return total
    answer=0
    for value in values:
        answer+=prefix(bisect.bisect_right(coordinates,value+diff))
        add(bisect.bisect_left(coordinates,value))
    return answer
